def test_update_fields(seeded):
    row = app.update_workout(seeded, 1, name="New", description="")
    assert row.id == 1 and row.name == "New" and row.description == ""
    assert seeded.get(app.Workout, 2).name == "B"

def test_partial_and_empty_update(seeded):
    row = app.update_workout(seeded, 1, description="changed")
    assert row.name == "A" and row.description == "changed"
    assert app.update_workout(seeded, 1).name == "A"

test_update_is_durable.title: test_update_is_durable
test_update_is_durable.code:
def test_update_is_durable(seeded, engine):
    app.update_workout(seeded, 1, name="Saved")
    seeded.close()
    with Session(engine) as check:
        assert check.get(app.Workout, 1).name == "Saved"

test_invalid_field_is_atomic.title: test_invalid_field_is_atomic
test_invalid_field_is_atomic.code:
def test_invalid_field_is_atomic(seeded):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        app.update_workout(seeded, 1, name="Must not change", id=7)
    assert seeded.get(app.Workout, 1).name == "A"
    assert seeded.get(app.Workout, 7) is None

test_delete_is_durable.title: test_delete_is_durable
test_delete_is_durable.code:
def test_delete_is_durable(seeded, engine):
    assert app.delete_workout(seeded, 1) is True
    assert app.delete_workout(seeded, 1) is False
    seeded.close()
    with Session(engine) as check:
        assert check.get(app.Workout, 1) is None and check.get(app.Workout, 2).name == "B"

courseHelp.body:
Write your implementation above the supplied tests. Run checks the sample tests. Submit checks all supplied tests. Keep the tests and runner unchanged.

For an older saved solution, use **+** beside the editor tabs to open the current template. Copy your implementation into the new tab. Your old tab stays in place.

These templates and tests are recreations from the public descriptions. The original templates and tests require Pybites premium. The runtime supplies SQLModel, SQLite, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, FastAPI, HTTPX, and pytest. Each check uses a separate database. No server is needed. Select Python.
